fabric_of_blossoms.text_zh: 装备春华。若你没有，此牌无效。
fabric_of_blossoms.text_en: Equip Blossom of Spring. If you don't, negate this.

fabric_of_hope.text_zh: 装备希望商贩兜帽。若你没有，此牌无效。
fabric_of_hope.text_en: Equip Hope Merchant's Hood. If you don't, negate this.

fabric_of_providence.text_zh:
传奇
装备天佑之冠。若你没有，此牌无效。
fabric_of_providence.text_en:
Legendary
Equip Crown of Providence. If you don't, negate this.

fabric_of_scales.text_zh: 装备金鱼草鳞甲。若你没有，此牌无效。
fabric_of_scales.text_en: Equip Snapdragon Scalers. If you don't, negate this.

fabric_of_spring.text_zh: 装备菲恩达尔的春日外衣。若你没有，此牌无效。
fabric_of_spring.text_en: Equip Fyendal's Spring Tunic. If you don't, negate this.

fabricate.text_zh:
选择2个；
从你的物品栏装备一件名称中含有原型的带有基础名称的装备。
本回合你控制的进化永久物获得+1防御。
将此牌置于你控制的一个进化永久物之下。
你可以放逐你手牌中的一张进化牌。若如此做，抽一张牌。
fabricate.text_en:
Choose 2;

Equip a base equipment with Proto in its name from your inventory.
Evo permanents you control get +1{d} this turn.
Put this under an Evo permanent you control.
You may banish an Evo from your hand. If you do, draw a card.

face_adversity.text_zh:
仅当攻击的操控者本回合抽过牌时，此牌才能防御该攻击。
刃碎
face_adversity.text_en:
This may only defend an attack if the attack's controller has drawn a card this turn.
Blade Break

face_purgatory.type_zh: 符文剑士 装备·头部
face_purgatory.text_zh:
当此牌与一张攻击行动牌和一张非攻击行动牌一起防御时，攻击英雄弃一张牌，你抽一张牌。
刃碎
face_purgatory.text_en:
When this defends together with an attack action card and a non-attack action card, the attacking hero discards a card and you draw a card.
Blade Break

fact_finding_mission.text_zh: 当此牌命中英雄时，你可以查看其军械库或装备区域中的一张牌面朝下的牌。
fact_finding_mission.text_en: When this hits a hero, you may look at a face-down card in their arsenal or equipment zones.

fai.text_zh:
你可以以坟场中一张凤凰烈焰开始游戏。
每回合一次瞬间——支付3点资源：将你坟场中的一张凤凰烈焰移回你的手牌。每当你控制一个龙裔链环，此异能费用减少1点资源。
fai.text_en:
You may start the game with a Phoenix Flame in your graveyard.
Once per Turn Instant - {r}{r}{r}: Return a Phoenix Flame from your graveyard to your hand. This ability costs {r} less for each Draconic chain link you control.

fai_rising_rebellion.text_zh:
你可以以坟场中一张凤凰烈焰开始游戏。
每回合一次瞬间——支付3点资源：将你坟场中的一张凤凰烈焰移回你的手牌。每当你控制一个龙裔链环，此异能费用减少1点资源。
fai_rising_rebellion.text_en:
You may start the game with a Phoenix Flame in your graveyard.
Once per Turn Instant - {r}{r}{r}: Return a Phoenix Flame from your graveyard to your hand. This ability costs {r} less for each Draconic chain link you control.

falcon_wing.type_zh: 游侠 行动·箭矢 攻击
falcon_wing.text_zh:
若隼翼带有一个瞄准指示物，它获得+1力量。
再动
falcon_wing.text_en:
If Falcon Wing has an aim counter, it has +1{p}.
Go again

familiar_stench.text_zh: 当1张或更多蛮将牌防御此牌时，创造一个活力衍生物。
familiar_stench.text_en: When 1 or more Brute cards defend this, create a Vigor token.

familiar_story.text_zh: 当1张或更多守护者牌防御此牌时，创造一个自信衍生物。
familiar_story.text_en: When 1 or more Guardian cards defend this, create a Confidence token.

fang.text_zh:
每当你命中被标记的英雄时，创造一个效忠衍生物。
若你控制3个或更多效忠衍生物，你启动匕首攻击的费用减少1点资源。
fang.text_en:
Whenever you hit a marked hero, create a Fealty token.
If you control 3 or more Fealty tokens, dagger attacks cost you {r} less to activate.

fang_dracai_of_blades.text_zh:
每当你命中被标记的英雄时，创造一个效忠衍生物。
若你控制3个或更多效忠衍生物，你启动匕首攻击的费用减少1点资源。
fang_dracai_of_blades.text_en:
Whenever you hit a marked hero, create a Fealty token.
If you control 3 or more Fealty tokens, dagger attacks cost you {r} less to activate.

fang_strike.type_zh: 秘法 刺客 攻击反应
fang_strike.text_zh:
短暂
目标攻击行动牌获得+1力量。
fang_strike.text_en:
Ephemeral
Target attack action card gets +1{p}.

farflight_longbow.text_zh:
瞬间——支付1点资源，横置此牌：将你手牌中的一张箭矢正面朝上放入你的军械库。
你的箭矢攻击可以以任意对手英雄或盟友为目标。
farflight_longbow.text_en:
Instant - {r}, {t}: Put an arrow from your hand face-up into your arsenal.
Your arrow attacks may target any opposing hero or ally.

fast_and_furious.text_zh:
推进
若本回合你上弦过，此牌获得+1力量。
当此牌因推进被放逐时，在你控制的一个具有上弦的物品上放置一个蒸汽指示物。
fast_and_furious.text_en:
Boost
If you've cranked this turn, this gets +1{p}.
When this is banished from boosting, put a steam counter on an item you control with crank.

fasting_carcass.text_zh:
本回合你使用的下一张红色行动牌获得再动。
再动
血债
fasting_carcass.text_en:
The next red action card you play this turn gets go again.
Go again
Blood Debt

fatal_engagement.text_zh:
仅当此链环中有攻击行动牌在防御时才能使用此牌。
目标攻击获得+5力量。
fatal_engagement.text_en:
Play this only if an attack action card is defending this chain link.
Target attack gets +5{p}.

fatigue_shot.type_zh: 游侠 行动·箭矢 攻击
fatigue_shot.text_zh: 当疲乏箭命中英雄时，该英雄在其下一个回合期间使用的第一张攻击行动牌的基础力量减半（向上取整）。
fatigue_shot.text_en: When Fatigue Shot hits a hero, the base {p} of the first attack action card they play during their next turn is halved, rounded up.

fault_line.text_zh:
若你军械库中有一张牌，此牌获得+1力量。
粉碎——当此牌对英雄造成4点或更多伤害时，将所有军械库中的所有牌置于其拥有者的牌库底。
fault_line.text_en:
If you have a card in your arsenal, this gets +1{p}.
Crush - When this deals 4 or more damage to a hero, put all cards in all arsenals on bottom of their owner's deck.

fealty.text_zh: 瞬间——摧毁此牌：本回合你使用的下一张牌视为龙裔。在你的结束阶段开始时，若本回合你尚未创造效忠衍生物或使用过龙裔牌，摧毁此牌。
fealty.text_en: Instant - Destroy this: The next card you play this turn is Draconic. At the beginning of your end phase, if you haven't created a Fealty token or played a Dragonic card this turn, destroy this.

fearless_confrontation.text_zh: 瞬间——弃掉此牌：目标攻击获得-1力量，并失去且不能获得支配。
fearless_confrontation.text_en: Instant - Discard this: Target attack gets -1{p} and loses and can't gain dominate.

feign_death.text_zh:
仅当你的英雄本回合受到过伤害时才能使用装死。
本回合你的英雄下一次将受到伤害时，防止它。
feign_death.text_en:
Play Feign Death only if your hero has been dealt damage this turn.
The next time your hero would be dealt damage this turn, prevent it.

feign_vengeance.text_zh:
当此链环结算时，若有牌防御此牌，抽一张牌。
再动
feign_vengeance.text_en:
When this chain link resolves, if there is a card defending this, draw a card.
Go again

feisty_locals.text_zh: 若此牌被行动牌防御，此牌获得+2力量。
feisty_locals.text_en: If this is defended by an action card, this gets +2{p}.

felling_of_the_crown.text_zh:
若你的放逐区有四张或更多大地牌，此牌获得+4力量。
分解——当此牌攻击时，你可以放逐坟场中的两张大地牌和一张行动牌。若如此做，每位英雄将手牌中的一张牌置于其牌库底。
felling_of_the_crown.text_en:
If there are 4 or more Earth cards in your banished zone, this gets +4{p}.
Decompose - When this attacks, you may banish 2 Earth cards and an action card from your graveyard. If you do, each hero puts a card from their hand on the bottom of their deck.

felling_swing.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次斧攻击获得+6力量。
再动
felling_swing.text_en:
Your next axe attack this turn gains +6{p}.
Go again

fender_bender.text_zh:
推进
此牌获得+X力量，X为防御它的装备数量。
fender_bender.text_en:
Boost
This gets +X{p}, where X is the number of equipment defending it.

feral_instinct.text_zh: 若本回合你威吓过一位对手，此牌的使用费用减少3点资源。
feral_instinct.text_en: If you've intimidated an opponent this turn, this costs {r}{r}{r} less to play.

fertile_ground.text_zh:
获得2点生命。
若你的放逐区有四张或更多大地牌，改为获得5点生命。
fertile_ground.text_en:
Gain 2{h}
If there are 4 or more Earth cards in your banished zone, instead gain 5{h}.

fervent_forerunner.text_zh:
若热忱先锋命中，占卜2。
若热忱先锋是从军械库使用的，它获得再动。
fervent_forerunner.text_en:
If Fervent Forerunner hits, opt 2.
If Fervent Forerunner is played from arsenal, it gains go again.

fiddle_dee.text_zh: 行动——摧毁此牌：每位英雄创造一个力量衍生物。再动
fiddle_dee.text_en: Action - Destroy this: Each hero creates a Might token.  Go again

fiddlers_green.text_zh: 当此牌从任何区域置入你的坟场时，获得3点生命。
fiddlers_green.text_en: When this is put into your graveyard from anywhere, gain 3{h}.

fight_dirty.text_zh:
若此牌被崇敬牌防御，此牌获得+1力量。
当此牌命中崇敬英雄时，摧毁其牌库顶的一张牌。
fight_dirty.text_en:
If this is defended by a Revered card, this gets +1{p}.
When this hits a Revered hero, destroy the top card of their deck.

fight_fair.text_zh:
若此牌被憎恶牌防御，此牌获得+1力量。
当此牌命中憎恶英雄时，将此牌置于其拥有者的牌库底。
fight_fair.text_en:
If this is defended by a Reviled card, this gets +1{p}.
When this hits a Reviled hero, put this on the bottom of its owner's deck.

fight_from_behind.text_zh: 当此牌攻击或防御时，若你的生命低于其他每位英雄，观众为你欢呼。
fight_from_behind.text_en: When this attacks or defends, if you have less {h} than each other hero, the crowd cheers you.

fight_night_prize_purse.text_zh: 选择一位对手。你与该对手各创造一个金币衍生物。
fight_night_prize_purse.text_en: Choose an opponent. You each create a Gold token.

fightmaster_kox.text_zh: 行动——横置此牌，摧毁你控制的一个金币：查看事件牌库顶的3张牌，然后以任意顺序放回。再动
fightmaster_kox.text_en: Action - {t}, destroy a Gold you control: Look at the top 3 cards of the event deck, then put them back in any order. Go again

figment_of_erudition.type_zh: 光 幻术师 瞬间·Figment
figment_of_erudition.text_zh:
传奇
当此牌进入竞技场时，创造一个沉思衍生物。
figment_of_erudition.text_en:
Legendary
When this enters the arena, create a Ponder token.

figment_of_judgment.type_zh: 光 幻术师 瞬间·Figment
figment_of_judgment.text_zh:
传奇
当此牌进入竞技场时，你可以将任意放逐区中的一张牌翻为牌面朝下。
figment_of_judgment.text_en:
Legendary
When this enters the arena, you may turn a card in any banished zone face-down.

figment_of_protection.type_zh: 光 幻术师 瞬间·Figment
figment_of_protection.text_zh:
传奇
当此牌进入竞技场时，创造一个幻质护盾衍生物。
figment_of_protection.text_en:
Legendary
When this enters the arena, create a Spectral Shield token.

figment_of_ravages.type_zh: 光 幻术师 瞬间·Figment
figment_of_ravages.text_zh:
传奇
当此牌进入竞技场时，对任意目标造成1点秘法伤害。
figment_of_ravages.text_en:
Legendary
When this enters the arena, deal 1 arcane damage to any target.

figment_of_rebirth.type_zh: 光 幻术师 瞬间·Figment
figment_of_rebirth.text_zh:
传奇
当此牌进入竞技场时，你可以将你坟场中的一张黄色行动牌置于你的牌库顶。
figment_of_rebirth.text_en:
Legendary
When this enters the arena, you may put a yellow action card from your graveyard on top of your deck.

figment_of_tenacity.type_zh: 光 幻术师 瞬间·Figment
figment_of_tenacity.text_zh:
传奇
当此牌进入竞技场时，你本回合的下一次攻击获得支配。
figment_of_tenacity.text_en:
Legendary
When this enters the arena, your next attack this turn gets dominate.

figment_of_triumph.type_zh: 光 幻术师 瞬间·Figment
figment_of_triumph.text_zh:
传奇
当此牌进入竞技场时，本回合你对手控制的攻击行动牌获得-1力量。
figment_of_triumph.text_en:
Legendary
When this enters the arena, attack action cards your opponents control get -1{p} this turn.

figment_of_war.type_zh: 光 幻术师 瞬间·Figment
figment_of_war.text_zh:
传奇
当此牌进入竞技场时，创造一个勇气衍生物。
figment_of_war.text_en:
Legendary
When this enters the arena, create a Courage token.

final_act.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，它获得+X力量，X为所有资源区中牌数量的两倍。
final_act.text_en: When this attacks, it gets +X{p}, where X is twice the number of cards in all pitch zones.

find_center.text_zh: 连击——若鹤舞是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，寻真中心不能被费用少于你控制的链环数量的牌防御，并获得“若此牌命中，创造一个禅定衍生物。”
find_center.text_en: Combo - If Crane Dance was the last attack this combat chain, Find Center can't be defended by cards with {r} cost less than the number of chain links you control, and it gains "If this hits, create a Zen State token."

fingers_of_fragmentation.text_zh: 瞬间——支付2点资源，摧毁此牌：目标已碎裂的攻击行动牌获得+2力量。
fingers_of_fragmentation.text_en: Instant - {r}{r}, destroy this: Target attack action card that has fragmented gets +2{p}.

fire_and_brimstone.type_zh: 龙裔 战士 攻击反应
fire_and_brimstone.text_zh:
传奇
每当你控制一个龙裔链环，此牌的使用费用减少1点资源。
你控制的匕首获得+1力量，且本回合你可以用它们每把额外攻击一次。
fire_and_brimstone.text_en:
Legendary
This costs {r} less to play for each Draconic chain link you control.
Daggers you control get +1{p} and you may attack with each of them an additional time this turn.

fire_in_the_hole.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次箭矢攻击获得+3力量。
你可以重置你控制的一把弓。
再动
fire_in_the_hole.text_en:
Your next arrow attack this turn gets +3{p}.
You may {u} a bow you control.
Go again

fire_tenet_strike_first.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，本战斗链中你的下一次龙裔攻击获得+1力量。
再动
fire_tenet_strike_first.text_en:
When this attacks, your next Draconic attack this combat chain gets +1{p}.
Go again

fire_that_burns_within.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，你可以弃一张凤凰烈焰。若如此做，抽一张牌且此牌获得+2力量。
再动
fire_that_burns_within.text_en:
When this attacks, you may discard a Phoenix Flame. If you do, draw a card and this gets +2{p}.
Go again

firebreathing.text_zh: 瞬间——支付1点资源：喷火获得+1力量。仅当喷火正在攻击时才能启动此异能。
firebreathing.text_en: Instant - {r}: Firebreathing gains +1{p}. Activate this ability only while Firebreathing is attacking.

firewall.text_zh: 当此牌防御时，展示你牌库顶的一张牌。若其为进化牌，将其置于你的牌库顶。否则，将其置于牌库底。
firewall.text_en: When this defends, reveal the top card of your deck. If it's an Evo, put it on top of your deck. Otherwise, put it on the bottom.

first_tenet_of_chi_moon.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次蓝色攻击获得“当此牌攻击时，抽一张牌。”
再动
first_tenet_of_chi_moon.text_en:
Your next blue attack this turn gets "When this attacks, draw a card."
Go again

first_tenet_of_chi_tide.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次蓝色攻击获得+2力量。
再动
first_tenet_of_chi_tide.text_en:
Your next blue attack this turn gets +2{p}.
Go again

first_tenet_of_chi_wind.text_zh:
本回合你使用的下一张蓝色行动牌获得再动。
再动
first_tenet_of_chi_wind.text_en:
The next blue action card you play this turn gets go again.
Go again

fish_fingers.text_zh:
行动——支付1点资源，摧毁此牌：你本回合的下一次攻击获得+1力量。再动
刃碎
fish_fingers.text_en:
Action - {r}, destroy this: Your next attack this turn gets +1{p}. Go again
Blade Break

fist_pump.text_zh:
每当你因推进放逐一张超频驱动器时，本回合你控制的目标扳手获得+1力量。
战痕
fist_pump.text_en:
Whenever you banish a Hyper Driver from boosting, target wrench you control gets +1{p} this turn.
Battleworn

fisticuffs.text_zh: 攻击反应——支付2点资源，摧毁挥拳：目标攻击行动牌获得+1力量。
fisticuffs.text_en: Attack Reaction - {r}{r}, destroy Fisticuffs: Target attack action card gains +1{p}.

fix_the_match.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，从你的牌库中搜寻一张牌，然后洗牌并将该牌置于牌库顶。
每当牌防御此牌时，与防御英雄交锋。胜者创造一个力量衍生物。
fix_the_match.text_en:
When this attacks, search your deck for a card, then shuffle and put that card on top.
Whenever a card defends this, clash with the defending hero. The winner creates a Might token.

flail_of_agony.type_zh: 暗影 符文剑士 武器·Flail （单手）
flail_of_agony.text_zh:
温塞特专精
每回合一次行动——支付生命：攻击
当此牌命中时，创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。
flail_of_agony.text_en:
Vynnset Specialization
Once per Turn Action - {h}: Attack
When this hits, create a Runechant token.

flake_out.type_zh: 元素 游侠 行动·箭矢 攻击
flake_out.text_zh:
冰融合
若飘落已融合，它获得支配。
flake_out.text_en:
Ice Fusion
If Flake Out was fused, it gains dominate.

flameborn_retribution.text_zh:
当你用烈焰所生之报复防御时，若本回合你受到过伤害，你可以将你坟场中的一张凤凰烈焰移回你的手牌。
再动
flameborn_retribution.text_en:
When you defend with Flameborn Retribution, if you've been dealt damage this turn, you may return a Phoenix Flame from your graveyard to your hand.
Go again

flamecall_awakening.text_zh:
当你用唤火觉醒攻击时，若本回合你使用过另一张红色牌，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张凤凰烈焰，展示它，将其置入你的手牌，然后洗牌。
再动
flamecall_awakening.text_en:
When you attack with Flamecall Awakening, if you've played another red card this turn, you may search your deck for a Phoenix Flame, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
Go again

flamescale_furnace.text_zh:
每回合一次瞬间——支付1点资源：你资源区中每有一张红色牌，获得1点资源。仅当本回合你使用过一张红色牌时才能启动此异能。

frontline_scout.text_zh:
你可以查看防御英雄的手牌。
若前线斥候是从军械库使用的，它获得再动。
frontline_scout.text_en:
You may look at the defending hero's hand.
If Frontline Scout is played from arsenal, it gains go again.

frost_fang.text_zh: 若冰霜獠牙命中英雄，该英雄弃一张牌，除非其支付2点资源。
frost_fang.text_en: If Frost Fang hits a hero, they discard a card unless they pay {r}{r}.

frost_hex.type_zh: 冰 法师 行动·Affliction 光环
frost_hex.text_zh:
艾斯兰德专精
你控制的霜咬获得“在你的结束阶段开始时，此牌对你造成1点秘法伤害。”
frost_hex.text_en:
Iyslander Specialization
Frostbites you control have "At the beginning of your end phase, this deals 1 arcane damage to you."

frost_lock.type_zh: 元素 游侠 行动·箭矢 攻击
frost_lock.text_zh:
本回合牌和启动式异能对对手英雄而言额外消耗1点资源。
若霜锁已融合，它获得+1力量，以及“若此牌命中英雄，直到其下一个回合结束，该英雄不能资源或使用基础费用为0的牌。”
frost_lock.text_en:
Ice Fusion
Cards and activated abilities cost opposing heroes an additional {r} this turn.
If Frost Lock was fused, it gains +1{p} and "If this hits a hero, until the end of their next turn they can't pitch or play cards with base cost 0."

frost_spike.text_zh: 在一个暴露的头部、胸部、手臂或腿部区域创造一个霜咬衍生物。
frost_spike.text_en: Create a Frostbite token in an exposed head, chest, arms, or legs zone.

frostbite.text_zh:
牌和异能使用或启动费用额外增加1点资源。
在你的结束阶段开始时或当你使用牌或启动异能时，摧毁霜咬。
frostbite.text_en:
Cards and abilities cost you an additional {r} to play or activate.
At the beginning of your end phase or when you play a card or activate an ability, destroy Frostbite.

frosthaven_sheath.text_zh: 冰羁绊——若你为使用此牌资源过一张冰牌，在攻击英雄的控制下创造一个霜咬衍生物。
frosthaven_sheath.text_en: Ice Bond - If an Ice card was pitched to play this, create a Frostbite token under the attacking hero's control.

frosting.text_zh: 对任意目标造成3点秘法伤害。
frosting.text_en: Deal 3 arcane damage to any target.

frozen_to_death.text_zh:
冰融合
若此牌已融合，你可以摧毁一个带有-1防御指示物的装备。
你可以在一个暴露的头部、胸部、手臂或腿部区域创造一个霜咬衍生物。
frozen_to_death.text_en:
Ice Fusion
If this was fused, you may destroy an equipment with a -1{d} counter.
You may create a Frostbite token in an exposed head, chest, arms, or legs zone.

fruits_of_the_forest.text_zh: 瞬间——弃掉此牌：获得2点生命。

fuel_injector.text_zh: 瞬间——将此牌置于其拥有者的牌库底：获得1点资源。
fuel_injector.text_en: Instant - Put this on the bottom of its owner's deck: Gain {r}

full_of_bravado.text_zh: 当此牌攻击或防御时，若你控制一个悬念光环，创造一个自信衍生物。
full_of_bravado.text_en: When this attacks or defends, if you control an aura of suspense, create a Confidence token.

fulminate.text_zh:
大地和/或闪电融合
若爆裂以一张大地牌融合，本回合你控制的攻击行动牌获得+3力量。
若爆裂以一张闪电牌融合，本回合你控制的攻击行动牌获得再动。
再动
fulminate.text_en:
Earth and/or Lightning Fusion
If Fulminate was fused with an Earth card, attack action cards you control gain +3{p} this turn.
If Fulminate was fused with a Lightning card, attack action cards you control gain go again this turn.
Go again

你可以从你的放逐区使用此牌。

创造一个符文吟唱衍生物。

You may play this from your banished zone.
If a hero has lost {h} this turn, you may play this as though it were an instant.
Create a Runechant token.

future_sight.text_zh: 创造3个命运印记衍生物。

fyendals_fighting_spirit.text_en: When this attacks or defends, if you have less {h} than an opposing hero, gain 1{h}.

在你的回合开始时，若此牌上的能量指示物少于3个，你可以在其上放置一个能量指示物。
